vote.title: To appoint Stephen Sayre, Deputy Chief of Staff, Office of the Mayor, 90 W. Broad Street, Columbus, OH 43215, to serve on the Mid-Ohio Regional Planning Commission, to represent the City of Columbus' interests, in his official capacity, until such time as the appointment is rescinded or he resigns (biography attached).

Title
 
To appoint Stephen Sayre, Deputy Chief of Staff, Office of the Mayor, 90 W.
